Construction Services in Haysville, KS

Haysville is a south Sedgwick County city of roughly 12,000 residents along US-81 between Wichita and Derby. The housing stock spans several decades — older 1960s and 1970s ranch homes in the original Haysville neighborhoods near downtown, 1980s and 1990s developments on the north and east edges, and some newer construction in the most recent growth areas along the south perimeter.

Haysville is a working-class community with well-established neighborhoods and strong homeownership. Renovation investment here tends to be practical and value-focused — homeowners who have been in their houses for 15 to 25 years and are ready to update for the long haul. Wheatland Construction serves Haysville regularly and we permit through the City of Haysville.

What We Build in Haysville

Custom Homes

Haysville's active development on the south edge has available lots for new custom home construction. We build in Haysville from foundation through finish — permitting through the City of Haysville and coordinating all construction with our own crews. See Custom Home Building in Haysville →

Home Additions

Haysville's established ranches from the 1960s through 1980s were built at modest square footages — and families who have been in these homes for 20 years frequently need more space. Room additions, garage expansions, and master bedroom buildouts are practical investments in Haysville's affordable housing market. See Home Additions in Haysville →

Basement Finishing

Haysville's older ranches — particularly the 1960s block-wall basements in the original neighborhoods near the Kansas turnpike interchange — need thorough moisture assessment before finishing. We camera-inspect drain lines in older basements and assess foundation walls for seepage before framing starts. Haysville's newer construction has better structural basements that are more straightforward to finish. See Basement Finishing in Haysville →

Bathroom Remodeling

Haysville's 1960s and 1970s bathrooms are well past their useful life in many homes — original fiberglass surrounds, original galvanized supply lines, and dated fixtures. The 1980s and 1990s bathrooms that replaced them are now themselves overdue. We remodel Haysville bathrooms completely: new tile, new vanity, new fixtures, and updated supply and drain work where the original systems need it. See Bathroom Remodeling in Haysville →

Kitchen Remodeling

Haysville kitchens reflect the housing's practical character — functional layouts that work, but with materials and finishes from decades ago. We remodel for function and durability: cabinet replacement, countertop upgrade, improved lighting, and fixture updates that make the kitchen work better without unnecessary expense. See Kitchen Remodeling in Haysville →

Major Remodels

Haysville has a substantial stock of homes where comprehensive renovation makes more sense than targeted single-room updates — older properties where electrical, plumbing, and finish all need addressing at once. We handle major remodel scopes with coordinated trades and full City of Haysville permit coverage. See Major Remodels in Haysville →

Roofing

South Sedgwick County — including Haysville — sees heavy spring hail and wind activity. Haysville's older housing stock frequently has roofs that have been patched and re-patched. We install new roofing systems appropriate for Kansas storm exposure and handle insurance documentation when applicable. See Roofing in Haysville →

Haysville Permit Office

Residential construction in Haysville permits through the City of Haysville's building department. We handle all permit applications, inspection scheduling, and final approvals.
